## `ChangePassword`

**PUT** `/identity/v2/auth/password/change`

Update Password

Updates the Account Password using the current Password for verification.

### Example

```c#
public static async Task CallChangePassword(LoginRadiusClient client) {
    ChangePassword changePassword = new ChangePassword("<oldPassword>", "<newPassword>"); //Required
    Option<string> gRecaptchaResponse = new Option<string>("<gRecaptchaResponse>"); //Optional
    Option<string> gRecaptchaResponse2 = new Option<string>("<gRecaptchaResponse2>"); //Optional
    Option<bool> preventWebhook = new Option<bool>(true); //Optional
    Option<bool> xPreventWebhook = new Option<bool>(true); //Optional
    Option<string> hCaptchaResponse = new Option<string>("<hCaptchaResponse>"); //Optional
    Option<string> qqCaptchaTicket = new Option<string>("<qqCaptchaTicket>"); //Optional
    Option<string> qqCaptchaRandstr = new Option<string>("<qqCaptchaRandstr>"); //Optional
    Option<string> accessToken = new Option<string>("<accessToken>"); //Optional

    try {
        var response = await client.Password.ChangePasswordAsync(changePassword, gRecaptchaResponse, gRecaptchaResponse2, preventWebhook, xPreventWebhook, hCaptchaResponse, qqCaptchaTicket, qqCaptchaRandstr, accessToken);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```

| `X-PreventWebhook` | header | boolean | no | When true, suppresses webhook events for this operation. |

| `access_token` | query | string | no | Access Token of the User |
